Slips: one slip() helper rolls each level's slip rate for shots, defensive answers (late by 0.06 + 0.3 x (1 - skill) s), dribble taps, passes and rebound reads, so a Legend's slips are rare and small; counted in c.slips. Match state: the score margin tilts risk on a smooth curve that steepens near the end (was a switch at 3 points late) and a per-match mood (run of baskets) warms or cools it by personality. Offense: shot value uses the width of the on-target window; the dunk's own record and a rim protector at home move the drive; front/back roles and a per-possession dribble budget (2-4 .. 5-10 by level) are back as soft tilts (weights role, budget), never gates; a Legend sweeps what is left of a cock-back and dribbles out at once when no perfect line remains (still releases only on a perfect line); a fadeaway waits at most 0.4 s for its lean with a defender in reach; past PATIENCE waiting can never win, even when a lower-scoring option is on offer (fixes a 50.9 s Legend hold at seed 128: a dribble past its budget was offered but lost to WAIT, the iteration 28 stall again). Learning: the opponent's shot distance and drive direction (recorded but unused before) now move the stance and contest reach; its own swipes and dribbles lost near a defender move how often it swipes and dribbles; own record weighted by the level's learn rate. I panel: level, personality, mood, dribble budget, slips, own record, swipes, dribbles lost (AI.summary). Tools: ai-bench plays a FROZEN reference opponent (tools/ai-ref.js, the iteration 32 brain) so a change no longer moves its own yardstick, adds a versus mode (new vs old at the same level), ball-handling metrics (holdMax, holdAvg, stall, passes, lobs, oops, lost, behind, slips) and --compare; ai-selfplay tunes role/budget/lob too and checks the result against the reference.
